scope: Reachable normal/build dependency source inventory, including proc macros/build-time crates. Dev dependencies and other target branches are excluded from the selected tree. This is not a linker map, reproducible binary build or complete binary redistribution authorization. Cargo metadata and tree only; no build scripts or compilers executed.
obligations: Keep selected Noto OFL notices and font names with separately acquired unmodified fonts; generated reports do not inherit OFL.
Retain copyright/license/notice text for selected permissive alternatives; AND expressions require all named terms.

option-ext 0.2.0 is MPL-2.0: any executable redistribution must make its covered source available and tell recipients how to obtain it; exact source archive URL/hash is retained. This does not convert independent application files to MPL.

Embedded typst-assets terms remain applicable even when rendering disables embedded fonts; keep its entire notice including NewCM GPL-3.0 with Font/Distribution Exceptions, GUST and other asset notices.

A redistribution package would additionally need verified binary/source correspondence, Rust runtime/compiler attribution and complete accompanying-notice/source-access placement. The observed OS/Universal CRT/VCRUNTIME140 imports are not shipped here. No Typst executable or fonts are bundled.

packages.name: glidesort
packages.notice_gap: No dedicated full license text in pinned crate or source tree; README explicitly grants Apache-2.0/MIT. Full standard Apache-2.0 text is retained in upstream Typst LICENSE. Preserve grant/source when constructing redistribution notices.

packages.name: wasmparser
packages.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

resolution_limitation: Resolution used installed Cargo 1.99.0 against unchanged pinned lockfile and target/features, while upstream release workflow selects Rust 1.95.0. No compiler/linker reproduction is asserted.

native_c_review.source_policy: MSVC build.rs bypasses pkg-config and compiles the bundled xz-5.2 liblzma sources. 71 selected C files explicitly say public domain; two generated tables bind public-domain generators. Shell utilities, getopt and build-system GPL/LGPL files are not selected by this source list. Conservative catalog retains source-tree licenses without claiming they all govern the binary.

observed_binary_imports.limitation: OS APIs, Universal CRT and VCRUNTIME140.dll are provided by the Windows/VC runtime environment; none copied into the installer by this work.
